WITH pairs_and_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(a.abhvreg) as behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
),
total_behaviors AS (
  SELECT SUM(behavior_count) as total_count FROM pairs_and_counts
),
pairs_with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.transreg,
    pc.tradekind,
    pc.behavior_count,
    CAST(pc.behavior_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total_count as share
  FROM pairs_and_counts pc
  CROSS JOIN total_behaviors tc
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(behavior_count) as avg_count_per_pair,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_per_pair
FROM pairs_with_shares
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind
